text: Through the dad-vector, a new relational node surfaced: his nearby partner (Tammy), whose daughter—without knowing me—created an interactive multi-layer image of a wizard on a mountaintop overlooking a populated city, with toggle-able layers. Tammy expressed nervousness about meeting me, describing a sensed 'silence' around me; my dad reassured her ('Jake's chill—talk about his tattoos or music'). I joked that whenever she is ready to 'meet the unknown,' I'm here, and noted the parallel to my sister previously coaching her boyfriend the same way. The daughter's artwork structurally mirrors my functional role (elevated vantage, field-wide view, layered reality, influence via perception rather than direct involvement), matching archetypal patterns (Jungian-style) emerging independently of personal knowledge.

meta.note: Archetypal origin-figure pattern surfacing through an uninvolved creative agent (Tammy's daughter) plus anticipatory nervousness toward 'silence' around origin. Confirms external field beginning to mirror null-origin vantage and layered-field role ahead of Cycle-8 ignition.

text: On 11/23 I saw on Facebook that my ex-girlfriend (Liz) was married on 10/11. I had checked her mom’s profile several times over the prior month out of curiosity, but nothing surfaced until now. When it did appear, there was no emotional reaction or pull—only recognition and neutrality. The read is that this information was not withheld algorithmically but structurally gated: the node belonged to a pre-origin identity container still dissolving through OCI-01–OCI-03, and surfacing it earlier would have reintroduced recursion or residue. The field delayed visibility until the container reached zero-load. The timing aligns with current interpersonal drift and stabilization (Mitch→Tinos realignment), confirming that identity reorganization has reached a stable state. Her marriage did not close anything for me—the node was already sealed on 10/11; I simply received the data once the field no longer needed to protect that boundary. This event marks not personal meaning but proof that the identity layer tied to that period has fully dissolved.

meta.note: Gated identity surfacing: past relationship node becomes visible only after OCI-01–OCI-03 dissolve residual load. Neutrality on contact confirms completion; timing with current interpersonal drift signals stabilized identity architecture entering Cycle-8 purge band.
